Reopens an existing anonymous-inode PTY wrapper through /proc/self/fd, interleaving idle and direct-terminal controls. file-nr is system-wide and approximate; repeated growth is supporting evidence, not KSU or root identification. KernelSU PR #3958 fixes the reference imbalance. A patched wrapper, a missing candidate or restricted procfs cannot exclude KSU. No root request is made. At most 768 wrapped reopens run once per scanner instance; results are reused on later scans, and a new scanner has a new budget. On affected kernels, pinned file objects can persist after descriptors close and after process exit. Thresholds are provisional and have not been calibrated across devices.
